business_scope.primary_industry_name: Customs Clearance Brokerage and Bonded Transit Management

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (International Company registered with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law, French civil law, and customary kastom law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu–China Bilateral Investment Treaty on Promotion and Protection of Investments (signed 2006)
Vanuatu–New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement (signed 2010)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus) (signed 2017; in force 2020)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 21 of 2015 (as amended by Act No. 4 of 2018 and Act No. 40 of 2019); Companies Act [Cap. 191]; International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; International Companies (Amendment) Act No. 13 of 2017; Beneficial Ownership Information Act No. 27 of 2020; VFSC AML/CFT Rules and Guidelines; Vanuatu Customs Act No. 2 of 1981 (as amended), repealed and replaced in part by the Customs Act No. 22 of 2019

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum and Articles of Association of any upstream corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Companies in the shareholder's country of origin / Vanuatu Financial Services Commission
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a contracting party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; documents must pass notarization, foreign ministry certification, and legalization by a Vanuatu diplomatic mission or the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation and External Trade)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified UBO declaration (Beneficial Ownership Information Act Form BO-1 equivalent) together with passport copies and proof of residential address for every individual holding 25% or more of shares or control
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of residence of the beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notary attestation plus Vanuatu consular legalization chain)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing for any existing corporate shareholder or director entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Company Registry or regulatory authority of the parent entity's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille is not accepted for Vanuatu; requires consular legalization at the Vanuatu High Commission/Embassy or via Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds declaration for each substantive UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution holding the UBO's accounts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (signature verification, notarization, and Vanuatu consular legalization)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and domestic Vanuatu enforcement alerts; compulsory PEP identification using international commercial databases (e.g., World-Check, Dow Jones, Refinitiv) together with negative news and adverse-media checks; enhanced due diligence required for the customs brokerage sector (ISIC 5229 / NAICS 488510) because of its direct interface with cross-border trade, bonded transit, and duty revenue collection; ongoing transaction monitoring under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 21 of 2015 and VFSC AML/CFT Rules.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Companies Online Name Reservation and Registry Portal (https://www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Roman (Latin) script; statutory name forms are recognized in English and French (both official languages); Bislama transliterations are acceptable only where the proposed spelling follows an established official orthography and does not create phonetic confusion with an existing registered name; the name must be distinguishable on the VFSC register and must not contain misleading, offensive, or prohibited expressions.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Brokerage (prior Customs Department/VFSC endorsement required for customs brokerage scope)
Customs (prior Vanuatu Customs Department endorsement required)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The applicant may file a written extension request with the VFSC before expiry of the 30-day reservation window; a single 30-day renewal is available upon payment of the prescribed fee. If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant or its licensed registered agent must file a written notice of appeal with the Registrar of Companies / Commissioner within 14 days of the rejection notice, stating the grounds for reversal and supplying supporting evidence that the name satisfies section 11 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] and VFSC naming guidelines. The Registrar must determine the appeal within 14 days. A further appeal against an adverse determination lies to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu by originating application within 28 days of the Registrar's appellate decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Holding International Company (VU_IC): virtual office is permissible in the sense that the registered office may be the address of a VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila or Luganville, with no independent physical occupancy required. Operating customs brokerage branch (ISIC 5229/NAICS 488510): virtual office is NOT acceptable; the Vanuatu Customs Department requires the licensed customs broker to maintain a physical business office with accessible records within Vanuatu to satisfy the Customs Broker Licensing regime and commercial substance expectations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 38% (medium-high risk): the Vanuatu Customs Department and VFSC conduct coordinated unannounced on-site inspections of licensed customs brokerages and their registered offices on a rolling compliance cycle; the probability is elevated (between 35% and 45% annually) for trade-facing entities handling bonded transit and duty payments, and physical inspection likelihood increases if the registered agent is associated with multiple high-risk trade intermediaries.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the VFSC (Fees) Regulations and International Companies Act [Cap. 222] fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing fee plus market benchmark for BO register administration and UBO documentation custody

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for enhanced due diligence on a Medium_Risk_Enhanced customs brokerage intermediary under the AML/CFT Act No. 21 of 2015

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per notarial act and per UBO in the origin jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization of corporate and UBO document bundle through the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation and External Trade or nearest Vanuatu diplomatic mission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation and External Trade / Vanuatu diplomatic post
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular legalization fee schedule (Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; full legalization chain required)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Customs circular fee schedule and prevailing market benchmark for license pre-clearance due diligence

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], Vanuatu, in particular sections 6 (method of incorporation), 7 (memorandum of association), 8 (articles of association), 10 (share capital), 11 (registered office) and 12 (company secretary).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, International Companies and Trust Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association with registered agent declaration (Form IC-1)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; no escrow account requirement. The International Company must have at least one issued share, and capital may be expressed in any currency or on a no-par-value basis.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers' subscription to 1,000 ordinary shares of USD 0.10 each and the allotment recorded in the first share register are approved. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office at the address stated in the filed Memorandum and Articles of Association be adopted, and the authorized corporate service provider be instructed to maintain the statutory records. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Director Name] is appointed first director and [Secretary Name] is appointed secretary, each authorized to execute all incorporation filings, bank account forms, and regulatory applications. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the directors are authorized to obtain the customs broker license and operate the business in accordance with applicable laws.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appoint Registered Agent and Prepare Governing Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies and Trust Registry via VFSC-approved registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The intended incorporator instructs a VFSC-approved registered agent to prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association. The document must state the company name, proposed capital structure, registered office address, registered agent particulars, and include a declaration by the registered agent of eligibility under the International Companies Act. The first director and secretary should be identified and consent forms signed.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association draft
Consent and appointment forms for first director and secretary
Identity and address verification of beneficial owners and subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried for defective names, missing consents or inconsistent capital clauses, the registered agent may file amendments and resubmit to the Registry within 5 business days; any prescribed correction fee is settled before re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit Incorporation Dossier to VFSC Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, International Companies and Trust Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges the signed Memorandum and Articles of Association along with the cover sheet, statutory declarations and filing fee schedule via the VFSC online lodgement portal or in-person submissions at the VFSC office in Port Vila. The Registry checks statutory compliance, uniqueness of name, and conformity of proposed activities with permitted International Company operations.
required_dossiers: Signed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Notice of no residual standard company name objection
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Registry issues a deficiency query or objection, the registered agent must respond to the VFSC query letter within 14 days, revise the memorandum or articles as required, and pay the resubmission fee before the file is re-adjudicated.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pay State Incorporation Fees and Stamp Tax
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and Vanuatu Government Revenue (institutional banking)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent pays the VFSC incorporation fee and any applicable stamp duty from the client funds account. The payment reference must quote the proposed company name and registry queue number. The Registry issues an official fee receipt which must accompany the final certificate request.
required_dossiers: VFSC invoice or fee assessment notice
Payment receipt from VFSC or government revenue collection system
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is misapplication, the agent submits the bank statement and the VFSC fee receipt request within 3 business days to obtain a corrected allocation notice; overpayments are refunded via registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receive Certificate of Incorporation and Issue Share Certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, International Companies and Trust Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon statutory approval, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company registry number. The registered agent collects the certificate, verifies details against the submitted memorandum, and the first director executes share certificates for the initial subscribers and records the allotment in the register of members.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by VFSC
Register of members and share certificates
Registered agent confirmation of receipt of certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical errors in the company name or date, the agent files a correction request with VFSC under section 6 of the International Companies Act, supported by the original certificate and statutory declaration, with replacement within 7 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance, Bank Account and Licence Preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate registered agent; commercial banks; Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service for customs broker licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The first board meeting resolves the registered office and officer appointments as reflected in the incorporation file. The company opens a corporate bank account with the Customs Brokerage operating account and obtains a Tax Identification Number (TIN) for customs-related transactions if required. The director completes the customs broker licence application package for submission to Customs at the next stage.
required_dossiers: Corporate bank account onboarding forms and beneficial ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or customs authority queries the corporate documents, the registered agent provides notarized or apostilled copies and a board resolution confirmation; any missing information is resubmitted within 10 business days to avoid withdrawal of the application.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service, Customs and Excise Division; licensing administered by the Commissioner of Customs
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Customs Broker Licence under the Customs Act [Cap. 145] and Customs Brokers Regulations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation, Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C – EIA Exempt / Low-impact administrative office use; a registration-only environmental clearance may be required if a bonded warehouse, vehicle holding area or physical cargo inspection facility is operated.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office-only customs brokerage: no industrial discharge, no VOC emissions and no process wastewater. Where a bonded transit shed is operated, stormwater run-off must not cause contamination; any sanitary effluent must be discharged to a municipal sewer or approved septic system. Waste handling records and fuel storage controls must comply with the Waste Management Regulations and the Water Resources Management Act [Cap. 200].

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from Vanuatu Fire Services based on occupancy classification; building structural inspection and occupancy permit from the local municipal council or provincial building inspector; workplace health and safety registration and clearance from the Department of Labour; and customs bond security approved by the Commissioner of Customs.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; single-window agency for customs and inland revenue administration, official portal www.vrc.gov.vu. International Companies are incorporated and regulated by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC, www.vfsc.vu). No income tax registration is required because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, payroll tax, or dividend withholding tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the International Company (IC) through a licensed VFSC registered agent and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation and VFSC Certificate of Good Standing. Step 2: Apply to VRC for a Customs Broker Licence under the Customs Act and register as an ASYCUDA World user to obtain the electronic broker code required for all customs declarations. Step 3: Submit the standard Application for Taxpayer Registration to VRC to obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN), attaching the Certificate of Incorporation, certified identity documents of directors and shareholders, registered office evidence, and projected turnover statement. Step 4: If taxable turnover reaches or is expected to exceed VUV 4,000,000 in any 12-month period, mandatory VAT registration applies; voluntary VAT registration is permitted below this threshold. The VAT registration certificate states the VAT ID that must appear on tax invoices, customs entries, and brokerage documentation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: the Vanuatu International Company is statutorily exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, and all entity-level duties under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], subject only to the fixed annual VFSC government fee. VAT at 15% is a consumption tax that applies only to taxable supplies made in or into Vanuatu; an IC acting as a customs broker for domestic clients must account for output VAT on local brokerage services. ICs transacting exclusively with non-resident clients, on goods and services consumed outside Vanuatu, remain outside the VAT net or qualify for zero-rating.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election regime because it imposes no entity-level or shareholder-level income tax. Available statutory mechanisms: (a) voluntary VAT registration below the VUV 4,000,000 threshold; (b) application to VFSC for authorization to carry on specified business in Vanuatu, which triggers local business licence and VAT compliance obligations; (c) election to apply 0% VAT to qualifying exported goods and export-connected services; and (d) continuation or redomiciliation of the IC into or out of Vanuatu under the International Companies Act on a tax-neutral basis.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) enacted under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 246], administered by Vanuatu Revenue and Customs; customs duties and excise administered under the Customs Act and Excise Act.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 4,000,000 (four million vatu) of taxable supplies in any rolling 12-month period; mandatory registration within 30 days of exceeding the threshold; voluntary registration permitted below the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No domestic electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API reporting, or digital stamping mandate is currently enforced in Vanuatu. Customs clearance is fully electronic: all import, export, and transit declarations must be filed by licensed brokers through the ASYCUDA World single-window system, which applies automated risk-scoring and issues electronic customs release references. The broker's TIN/VAT ID is cross-linked with the ASYCUDA broker code; tax invoices must be issued in the prescribed format and all supporting records retained for 7 years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods are zero-rated where physically exported from Vanuatu within the period prescribed by the VAT Act and evidenced by an approved ASYCUDA export declaration. Services are zero-rated when supplied to a non-resident recipient located outside Vanuatu with the benefit consumed outside Vanuatu, or when the services are directly connected to goods exported from Vanuatu, including customs brokerage, port handling, and international freight. A licensed IC customs brokerage house may therefore apply 0% VAT to clearance services rendered on export cargo, provided the brokerage contract, customs entry, and transport documents consistently evidence the export movement. Input VAT on overheads attributable to zero-rated exports is creditable and refundable by VRC. Caution: an IC that breaches the International Companies Act by carrying on domestic business with Vanuatu residents may be denied the offshore exemption and become fully exposed to local tax and licensing liabilities.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: ASYCUDA World electronic Customs Export Declaration with customs release reference
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical export from Vanuatu
Brokerage services contract and zero-rated tax invoice
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank confirmation of foreign currency receipt of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC conducts post-clearance audits and reconciles ASYCUDA export declarations against shipping manifests and foreign-exchange receipts reported by authorized banks. Fraudulent zero-rating or fictitious export claims trigger full retrospective clawback of input VAT credits and refunds, plus late-payment interest at 20% per annum. Criminal prosecution under the VAT Act may result in fines up to VUV 200,000 and imprisonment up to 2 years; false customs declarations attract fines up to VUV 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 3 years under the Customs Act, in addition to forfeiture of goods, suspension or cancellation of the customs broker licence, and disqualification of the VFSC registered agent.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) is the exclusive monetary and foreign-exchange authority, administering the Exchange Control Act [CAP 116] as the National Exchange Control Administrator pursuant to the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [CAP 125]. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) supervises the International Company under the International Companies Act [CAP 222] and licensed financial dealers under the Financial Dealers Act 2011; Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (VCIR) licenses customs brokers under the Customs Act [CAP 145].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations (1982); the Vatu (VUV) is convertible for all current international transactions and the RBV publishes a daily official mid-rate against a basket of AUD, USD, NZD, EUR, and JPY. Capital-account transfers by resident persons remain subject to Exchange Control Act declaration or approval, but a Vanuatu International Company (VU_IC) benefits from a statutory exchange-control exemption under the International Companies Act [CAP 222], s.11, permitting unrestricted multi-currency accounts and free remittance of dividends, royalties, and liquidation proceeds. The practical profit-repatriation hurdles are therefore documentary rather than statutory: trade-based money-laundering controls require the customs broker to evidence the underlying brokerage contract, the VCIR customs-broker license, and the VFSC Certificate of Good Standing before an authorized dealer releases large outward telegraphic transfers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The Exchange Control Act [CAP 116] obliges resident exporters to ensure that foreign-currency export proceeds are paid to an authorized dealer in Vanuatu and, unless a specific exemption is granted, surrendered in exchange for Vatu within the timelines set by RBV Exchange Control Notices (in practice not later than 6 months after exportation). The mandatory conversion ratio for a nonexempt resident exporter is 100% of the export invoice value. However, an International Company is expressly exempt from exchange-control laws, so the VU_IC customs brokerage house is treated as a nonresident for this purpose: the compulsory surrender ratio is 0%, and export or brokerage-fee proceeds may be retained, converted, or remitted freely through its multi-currency accounts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for fully remote offshore electronic-money institutions; MEDIUM only where the EMI holds a VFSC Financial Dealer's Licence or an RBV banking licence with a physical Port Vila office and direct SWIFT/VATUS access. Legal constraints: the Banking Act [CAP 264] and the International Banking Act 2002 reserve deposit-taking to licensed banks; no domestic e-money issuance framework exists, so unlicensed offshore EMIs cannot lawfully maintain VUV payment accounts or act as the primary clearing bank for statutory customs duty payments, which must settle through an RBV-authorized commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Vanuatu's AML/CFT framework (Financial Intelligence Unit Act No. 22 of 2000) and standard bank policies require each director, beneficial owner, and authorized signatory to attend an in-person onboarding interview at the bank's Port Vila or Luganville branch; remote video KYC is permitted only where the applicant already maintains a banking relationship with the same banking group or a senior manager of the bank personally certifies the customer. For a Medium_Risk_Enhanced international customs brokerage IC, at least one director should appear physically, while remaining shareholders may complete notarized or lawyer-attested KYC packs in their country of residence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company structure without domestic operational proof (offshore shell red flag)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing; registered-agent letter; audited or accountant-prepared financial statements; executed lease agreement for the Vanuatu customs office; staff employment contracts and payroll records; board resolution approving account opening; VCIR customs broker licence issued under the Customs Act [CAP 145]; and an ASYCUDA World user licence confirmation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: 100% non-resident beneficial ownership combined with statutory tax-exempt status
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized passports and residential address proofs for every underlying beneficial owner; certified source-of-wealth statement supported by six months of bank statements; complete corporate ownership chain diagram; confirmation of beneficial-ownership filing under the Beneficial Ownership Act No. 17 of 2020; and a VFSC tax-exemption status letter confirming exemption under the International Companies Act [CAP 222] ss.10-11.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High expected transaction velocity from customs duty pass-through and bonded transit clearing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ASYCUDA World broker module registration and customs broker bond; three months of projected duty-payment schedules; named importer client list with customs accounts; signed brokerage services agreements; and a modelled monthly ledger demonstrating that funds are pass-through clearing flows rather than stored value.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Disbursements to freight forwarders, warehouses, or counterparties in high-risk foreign jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Counterparty KYC summaries; underlying trade documents (bills of lading, airway bills, customs declarations, bonded transit permits); per-transaction purpose mapping showing each disbursement matches an identified customs, freight, or warehouse liability; and client instruction records with audit trail integrity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital should be routed by the non-resident parent or beneficial owner via a single SWIFT MT103 to the designated operational account at ANZ, BSP, or BRED, quoting ISO 20022 purpose code 'ECAP' (Equity Capital) and, in the remittance narrative, 'Vanuatu International Company capital subscription - Customs Brokerage ISIC 5229'. The remitting bank must include the VFSC registration number and registered-agent name. The recipient RBV-authorized dealer will value-date the funds only after the KYC pack, board resolution, share certificate, and source-of-funds evidence (six months of bank statements plus a wealth declaration) are cleared. No prior RBV approval is required for an IC under the exchange-control exemption, but the receiving bank must submit a suspicious transaction report for any cash component exceeding the FIU threshold (VUV 1,000,000 equivalent).
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Customs duties and bonded-transit taxes are settled through the ASYCUDA World integrated payment module using bank-guaranteed debit authority with Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue; domestic VUV clearing executes in real time through the RBV-operated Vanuatu Automated Transfer System (VATUS), while cross-border freight, insurance, and foreign supplier payments use SWIFT MT103 (with MT202 for high-value AUD/USD/NZD/EUR/JPY transactions). Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP 600) and demand guarantees may be issued by authorized dealer banks where the brokerage acts as importer-of-record or bond provider for bonded transit. Every disbursement is matched against the customs declaration, broker invoice, and underlying client contract to satisfy trade-based AML controls.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright VUV/USD, VUV/AUD, and VUV/NZD forward contracts with an RBV-authorized dealer (tenor up to 12 months) supported by documented customs-fee receivables or duty-payment exposure
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in VUV executed through an approved cross-border counterparty desk, with thin onshore liquidity and documentary proof of genuine underlying trade exposure

Cross-currency swaps (VUV/USD, VUV/AUD) with licensed authorized dealers, subject to a demonstrable commercial purpose and, where the International Company exemption does not apply, to Exchange Control Act approval
Natural hedging through multi-currency operating accounts (VUV, USD, AUD, NZD, EUR, JPY) with matched receipts and disbursements; no onshore futures or exchange-traded options market exists for VUV
RBV-approved forward cover bridging the lag between an ASYCUDA duty obligation and client reimbursement in a different currency

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Return and Government Maintenance Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of registration; annual return must be filed within 30 days after each anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of up to 20% of annual fee; continued non-payment results in administrative strike-off after 6 months

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar year basis; renewal due on or before 1 January of each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Expiry of licence without renewal; inability to transact customs brokerage; potential monetary penalty and suspension

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit required for a standard International Company under VFSC rules
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS permitted on a voluntary basis; no mandatory local GAAP requirement

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually confirm to the registered agent the complete list of shareholders and any transfer of shares that occurred during the year; UBO details must be kept current with the registered agent at all times

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax at the national level; Vanuatu International Companies are exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax and stamp duty)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu International Companies benefit from a statutory tax exemption under the International Companies Act. The IC generally pays only an annual VFSC registration fee and fixed license fees; dividends, interest, royalties, rents and capital gains sourced through the IC are not subject to Vanuatu tax. VAT at 12.5% applies only to taxable goods and services supplied in Vanuatu; qualifying offshore supplies are outside the VAT net.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Vanuatu corporate income tax return exists or is prescribed. The only recurring filing obligations for an International Company are (a) the VFSC Annual Return filed through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) registry system, and (b) a Value Added Tax return filed with the Vanuatu VAT Office in Port Vila where the IC is VAT-registered because it makes local taxable supplies of customs brokerage services. Electronic filing is accepted where the VAT Office has registered the taxpayer for e-filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: No annual corporate income tax return. VAT registration, if applicable, requires monthly or quarterly VAT returns according to the turnover threshold. The VFSC Annual Return is an annual compliance filing, not a tax return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: There is no CIT filing deadline in Vanuatu. VAT returns and payments are due within the period stated in the VAT Act, generally not later than one month after the close of the relevant VAT tax period. The VFSC Annual Return must be submitted within the period prescribed under the International Companies Act, generally tied to the annual anniversary of the company's registration date; late filing triggers VFSC late fees and possible strike-off action.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Because Vanuatu does not levy corporate income tax, there are no income tax line items, chargeable income boxes, tax relief boxes or tax computation schedules to complete for an International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident owned Vanuatu IC does not file any income tax computation. The company should instead ensure its VFSC Annual Return identifies its registered agent, registered office, directors and ultimate beneficial owner as required by the International Companies Act and beneficial ownership rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT at 12.5% is chargeable on taxable supplies of customs brokerage facilitation services supplied in Vanuatu to clients that are not otherwise exempt. The VAT return reflects gross taxable income, output VAT, VAT charged on expenses, VAT paid on imports relating to local services, and the net VAT payable to the Vanuatu VAT Office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident IC whose customs brokerage services are performed wholly offshore and which has no local establishment or VAT registration enters zero output VAT and files a formal explanation with the VAT Office if registered. If the IC is a licensed customs broker with a physical Vanuatu presence, local services are subject to VAT and must be declared.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: There is no penalty for failing to file a non-existent corporate income tax return. However, late VAT returns attract monetary penalties, default assessments, daily late-filing surcharges and interest on unpaid VAT. Failure to submit the VFSC Annual Return or pay the annual fee exposes the IC to late fees, deregistration, and liability of directors for improper dissolution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (Vanuatu does not impose dividend withholding tax). Dividends declared and paid by a Vanuatu International Company to non-resident shareholders are not subject to Vanuatu tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu does not maintain a comprehensive double tax treaty network. As there is no Vanuatu income tax on dividends, interest, royalties or capital gains, there is no domestic withholding tax to mitigate and no Vanuatu procedure for submitting a Tax Residency Certificate to obtain treaty relief. A non-resident recipient that needs a country-by-country tax evidence document may request a VFSC-issued Certificate of Tax Exemption for the IC; any foreign tax credit relief is sought in the shareholder's own jurisdiction by filing the shareholder's TRC issued by its own fiscal authority. Vanuatu's information exchange agreements (for example TIEAs) are used for transparency purposes and do not reduce Vanuatu tax because Vanuatu tax is zero.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rate for cross-border royalties and interest is 0%. No Vanuatu tax treaty provides a reduced treaty rate because no such rate exists. An International Company may pay royalties for brands, software, logistics technology or franchise arrangements and interest to foreign creditors without Vanuatu withholding tax; however, if the payments relate to services used in a Vanuatu business, the VAT treatment at 12.5% must be separately assessed.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold in Vanuatu vatu (VUV) exists. Vanuatu has no domestic transfer pricing legislation requiring Master File, Local File or Country-by-Country reporting. As a practical compliance matter, a customs brokerage IC should maintain intercompany contracts, pricing benchmarks, commission rates, cost allocations and income statements in VUV to establish arm's-length conduct if challenged by the VFSC under economic substance rules or by foreign tax authorities applying international transfer pricing standards.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP (Comparable Uncontrolled Price) - acceptable for establishing agent commission for comparable customs clearance transactions
Resale Price Method - acceptable for pure distribution or logistics pass-through activities
Cost Plus Method - acceptable for low-risk customs brokerage processing functions
TNMM (Transactional Net Margin Method) - practical for benchmarking routine brokerage operating margin
Profit Split Method - acceptable where integrated logistics functions contribute unique intangible value
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Vanuatu International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations apply to International Companies carrying on relevant activities: banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, distribution and service center, intellectual property holding, and pure equity holding. Licensed customs brokerage as such is not automatically a listed 'relevant activity'; however, a customs brokerage IC that also offers logistics distribution, bonded transit management or agency services may cross into the distribution/service center category. A relevant IC must be directed and managed in Vanuatu, hold board meetings in Vanuatu, maintain adequate premises, employees and expenditure proportionate to core income-generating activities, and file the VFSC annual economic substance declaration. A customs broker that merely processes offshore paperwork without substance in Vanuatu will fail the economic substance test and can be struck off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and VAT / Customs Duty Fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly under-declaring customs brokerage income, issuing false invoices, concealing VAT liabilities, assisting a client in false import/export declarations to evade customs duty, or creating sham contracts and backdated agreements to disguise revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal prosecution under Vanuatu's Penal Code and Customs legal framework; court-imposed financial penalties; forfeiture and confiscation of the proceeds of crime; additional VAT assessments with interest and late-payment penalties; cancellation or suspension of the customs broker license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or direct fraudulent customs declarations may be prosecuted as principals or accessories. The corporate veil is pierced where the company is used as a facade, leaving directors jointly and severally liable for evaded duties, damages and tax. Travel bans, surrender of passports, asset freezes and imprisonment up to 10 years may follow on conviction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Vanuatu International Company as a pure shell: no physical office, no employees, no board minutes from Vanuatu, no substance declaration, no books and records, and no real management of customs brokerage operations in Vanuatu, yet continuing to receive commissions or holding itself out as a licensed customs brokerage house.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC strike-off, deregistration and potential dissolution of the IC; revocation of any tax exemption certificate; administrative penalties for non-filing; refusal, suspension or revocation of the customs broker license; inability to enforce contracts in Vanuatu courts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally responsible for the company's liabilities if the company traded while insolvent or was used as an instrument of fraud. Directors may be disqualified, ordered to pay outstanding annual fees and liquidation costs, made subject to travel restrictions, and subjected to civil restitution claims by creditors and authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a customs brokerage house without registering as a reporting entity under Vanuatu's anti-money laundering regime; failing to conduct customer due diligence on high-risk importers and beneficial owners; failing to appoint a Money Laundering Reporting Officer; enabling movement of funds connected to sanctions, trafficking, smuggling or fraud; or tipping off a customer about a suspicious transaction report.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Regulatory penalties and fines imposed by the Vanuatu FIU and VFSC; criminal penalties including imprisonment for wilful non-compliance; forfeiture of tainted property; revocation of the customs broker license; public disqualification from acting as a director.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual directors, officers and compliance officers may be prosecuted for money laundering or failure to report suspicious transactions. Conviction may carry custodial sentences, personal monetary fines, travel bans and asset seizure; corporate veil-piercing is available where the company is a conduit for illicit proceeds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Customs Brokerage and False Declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Acting as a customs broker or customs clearance intermediary without holding the required Vanuatu customs broker license; using a nominee-director IC structure to conceal the true licensed principal; presenting forged shipping bills, bills of lading, ACH entries, import declarations or customs valuation statements; or failing to remit customs fees and duties collected from clients.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties per customs infringement; seizure and forfeiture of goods; cancellation or non-renewal of the customs broker license; criminal prosecution for making or causing false declarations to Vanuatu Customs; contractual nullity of brokerage agreements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable where they exceed corporate authority, participate in forgery, or knowingly benefit from false declarations. The court may order civil restitution to the Government of Vanuatu, issue travel bans pending prosecution, and impose imprisonment in cases of deliberate fraudulent Customs evasion.
